'''grendelX Classic SYCFA Non-flip & Sandspeeders (DS)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[grendelX]]
* '''Published:''' 21 February 2005 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 SYCFA grendelX DS 2005 5933.txt |Download]] (omits Commander Praji (V), General Tagge (V), Motti (V), Tarkin (V), The Emperor (V), Stalker (V), Death Squadron (V), Fear Will Keep Them In Line (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Dark Side won once to finish 1-3 score 2(-18) for Classic tourney today...

== Notes ==

* GPN post 5933 holds two decks; this page is the Dark deck, and the Light deck is on the (LS) page.
* No Fear Is My Ally in this list, so No Escape, Resistance and Secret Plans are dested as Effects (in the 60), not shields.
* Posted Tarken (v) dested Tarkin (V); Lieutenant Commander Arden dested Lieutenant Commander Ardan.
* Original-era (V) cards: Commander Praji (V), General Tagge (V), Fear Will Keep Them In Line (V) (VS2); Motti (V) (VS3); Tarkin (V), Stalker (V), Death Squadron (V) (VS4); The Emperor (V) (VS6).

== Strategy ==

DS 2-3/LS 1-4 20 February 2005 Rating 1524
